<@&851447922301730836> All you crafters, have fun making your custom weapons and armor. I look forward to seeing what you come up with. But keep the following rules in mind:
1. You can NOT upgrade your +1 armor to +2 or +3. You CAN use your existing +1 armor as a crafting ingredient and pay the FULL cost of the +2 or +3 armor, not the difference, but it's the same cost to use a mundane sword.
2. A +1, +2, +3 sword can gain one additional ability. You CAN craft a +2 flame tongue sword for 4000+5000 = 9000. Or you can give your +2 sword the flame tongue ability for 5000. Or you can give your flame tongue sword +2 for 4000.
3. You can NOT stack multiple abilities onto your weapons. If you use a +1 sword of sharpness as an ingredient to make a +2 dancing sword, it will lose the +1 and sharpness abilities. You would be better of in this case just using a mundane sword, as the cost would be the same.
